aging.source_title: Delaware Division of Services for Aging and Adults with Physical Disabilities: Contact
aging.source_scope: Delaware Aging & Disability Resource Center, 1-800-223-9074 (TDD only 302-424-7141): the single point of contact for information, referrals and guidance on aging, disability and caregiving services; read in full. The page is undated. The division’s ADRC page says the ADRC serves people across the state, whatever their income or where they live in Delaware (https://dhss.delaware.gov/dsaapd/division-of-services-for-aging-and-adults-with-physical-disabilities/adrc/; search excerpt).
aging.description: The Delaware Aging & Disability Resource Center, run statewide by the Division of Services for Aging and Adults with Physical Disabilities: free information, referral and guidance on help at home, meals, caregiving, assistive devices, long-term care and other services for older adults, adults with physical disabilities and caregivers.
aging.next_step_extra: TDD users can call 302-424-7141. You can also email DelawareADRC@delaware.gov.

programs.name: Delaware veterans: Office of Veterans Services for claims help
programs.organization: Delaware Department of State, Office of Veterans Services
programs.description: Free help with VA claims, pension, survivor benefits and state veterans benefits from the Office of Veterans Services’ Veteran Service Officers. They work from the Dover headquarters and serve veterans in all three counties.
programs.next_step: Call 302-739-2792 or email dcva.vso@delaware.gov to reach a Veteran Service Officer.
constraints: There is one service office for the state, in Dover; call before visiting.

programs.name: Medicare counseling (Delaware Medicare Assistance Bureau, SHIP)
programs.organization: Delaware Department of Insurance, Delaware Medicare Assistance Bureau (DMAB)
programs.description: Free health insurance counseling for people with Medicare, including those under 65, from trained volunteers: Medicare, Medicaid, Medigap, Part D and long-term care insurance questions. DMAB is Delaware’s State Health Insurance Assistance Program.
programs.next_step: Call 1-800-336-9500 or 302-674-7364 to set up a free counseling session at a site near you. For Medicare itself, call 800-MEDICARE (800-633-4227).
constraints: Counseling is by appointment. Have your Medicare card and drug list ready.

programs.name: Delaware Long-Term Care Ombudsman and adult abuse reporting
programs.organization: Delaware Health and Social Services: Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program; Division of Services for Aging and Adults with Physical Disabilities, Adult Protective Services
programs.description: Advocacy for residents of nursing facilities, assisted living and board and care homes, and for people receiving home and community-based services. Adult Protective Services takes reports of abuse, neglect or exploitation of older adults and adults with disabilities.
programs.next_step: Call the ombudsman hotline at 1-855-773-1002 (you can stay anonymous). To report abuse of an adult, call Adult Protective Services at 1-888-277-4302 (Delaware Relay: 711). For a nursing home or assisted living resident, you can also call the Division of Health Care Quality, 1-877-453-0012, 24/7. If someone is in immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing agency.

programs.name: Free legal help for older Delawareans
programs.organization: Community Legal Aid Society, Inc. (CLASI), Elder Law Program
programs.description: CLASI’s Elder Law Program gives free legal help to Delaware residents 60 and older, with no income test: powers of attorney, advance directives, fraud and financial exploitation, and consumer, housing and benefits problems. CLASI also serves people with low incomes and people with disabilities through its county offices.
programs.next_step: If you are 60 or older, call the Elder Law Program at 302-575-0666. Or contact your county office: New Castle 302-575-0660 (Wilmington), Kent 302-674-8500 (Dover), Sussex 302-856-0038 (Georgetown); weekdays, by phone or in person.
constraints: The Elder Law Program does not do simple wills. CLASI does not take criminal or personal injury cases.

programs.name: VA health care in Delaware
programs.organization: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, VA Wilmington Healthcare System
programs.description: Delaware veterans are served by the VA Wilmington Healthcare System: the Wilmington VA Medical Center (1601 Kirkwood Highway, Wilmington; 302-994-2511) and community clinics in Kent and Sussex counties. Vet Centers in Wilmington (302-994-1660) and Georgetown (302-225-9110) offer readjustment counseling.
programs.next_step: For primary care appointments, call 800-461-8262 and select 2, or 302-994-2511. Not enrolled yet? Ask a Veteran Service Officer for help applying.
constraints: If a service you need is not offered near you, ask about travel benefits and community care.
